messages:
marta: Heads-up: were releasing Private telemetry anonymization v1 today. Goal: give regulated customers an easy opt-in to anonymized performance metrics (latency, error-rate) while minimizing PII in telemetry streams. Short notes and actions below.
liam: Nice. Does this affect audit logs or only telemetry/ops metrics?
noor: Telemetry only. Audit logs (auth events, API calls) remain intact unless customer explicitly requests reduced audit retention. This feature strips user identifiers from operational metrics we stream to central monitoring.
ethan: Implementation detail: we add tenant flag telemetry_mode = "anonymized". When set, we hash user_ids and redact IPs and account emails in emitted metrics. Example API to enable: 
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://private.redwood/api/v1/projects/777 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"telemetry_mode":"anonymized"}'
```
compliance-bot: compliance-bot: Note: for SOC2/GDPR customers, anonymized telemetry reduces risk surface but you must get explicit customer consent for any telemetry sharing with third-party monitoring. Addendum template in /legal/templates/telemetry-addendum.
marta: GTM: CSMs need a short script explaining difference between anonymized telemetry and audit logs. Can someone draft that?
liam: I'll create a 2-line CSM blurb and add to rollout doc. Also adding a console toggle with tooltip explaining the tradeoffs.
noor: Ops note: anonymized mode disables user-level breadcrumbs in traces (we still keep trace ids for latency aggregation). This may slightly reduce debug fidelity; we log that in the KB.
ethan: We also added a sampled debug mode that preserves full traces for a short time (24h) with explicit signed approval. API: POST /projects/:id/telemetry/trace-approval {duration_hours:24, reason:"debug"}.
ps-bot: PS-bot: Onboarding note: customers wanting help validating anonymization should book a PS session. Slots this week: Tue 10:00-12:00, Thu 15:00-17:00. Use /book-telemetry-ps <customer>.
marta: Action items: 1) Legal finalize telemetry addendum (compliance-bot) 2) CSM blurb + email (liam) 3) KB update on debug tradeoffs (noor) 4) Console toggle + API docs (ethan) 5) Monitor aggregated metrics for 48h post-rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-anon/v1 -> prod completed on pool-8 at 1783006200 :white_check_mark:
marta: Thanks all. We'll hold off broad customer announcements until legal sign-off but enable the API for early opt-ins. Ping here for any regressions or high-error signals.
